name: Dream Camp at Trinity College
operator_name: Trinity College and ESF Dream Camp Foundation
description_short: Free five week summer camp on the Trinity College campus for Hartford children, part of a year round mentoring program. Campers take arts, performing arts, health and fitness classes, swim and play sports, and older campers prepare for college and can serve as young leaders.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Trinity's page: founded 1998, now in its 29th season; summer classes in creative and performing arts, health and nutrition, fitness and athletics; each summer 150+ Hartford children ages 6 to 16. Office at 300 Summit Street, Hartford 06106, 860-987-6209. Operator named as Trinity College with the ESF Dream Camp Foundation, which the page links as the camp's own website.

Researched by Claude from this page. ESF Dream Camp's own page for the Trinity site: enrollment is full for Summer 2026 with a waitlist (sdubois@esfdreamcamp.org) that gets priority notice about Summer 2027; five weeks of summer camp, free of charge including meals and transportation; activities include visual and performing arts, music and video production, swimming, soccer, basketball.

warnings: No session dates are posted for 2026 or 2027; only that camp runs five weeks.
Summer 2026 enrollment is full with a waitlist.
The camp is free and serves children from under resourced Hartford communities; it is not a general enrollment camp.

for_andrew: Should a free camp aimed at Hartford children from under resourced communities, with 2026 enrollment full, be listed? If so, is 'free of charge' worth adding as a price of 0 once you set a rule for free camps?
